title: Vittoria padroncini!
subtitle: Despina, Ferrando, Don Alfonso and Guglielmo: recitative from Così fan tutte, Act 2

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 2 scene 14, recitative between No. 30 and No. 31 (the Finale)
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (notajo; quand' entra as two words). Ferrando, Don Alfonso and Guglielmo answer “Contentissimi” together (the libretto gives it to Guglielmo).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), page 310, the recitative between No. 30 and No. 31 (15 bars)
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, a separate sweep for marks, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). Where the print gives a second rhythm for the German words, the Italian rhythm is kept. The German singing translation is left out. In bars 11–12 the three men's “Contentissimi” is printed as chords on one bass-clef staff; the notes are given to Ferrando, Don Alfonso and Guglielmo, top to bottom, in the order the print names them. Bar 15 is for the piano alone (“Vorhang zu”, the curtain closes). It ends “segue Nr. 31 Finale”. Playback tempo: Free, as recitative is sung: played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 100, estimated (no separate timing of this recitative was found; about ½ minute).
